rationale: Repair the existing governed evidence-resolution responsibility by adding a publication-backed USER_ANSWER materialization path that reuses certified EvidencePackage claim/lineage data only when exact evidence references are admitted by an AuthoritativePublicationRecord. The core materializer and published resolver are topic-neutral; bounded Star routing remains an adapter under the existing evidence capability. No new insurance fact, reasoning rule, publication authority, recommendation authority, or domain capability is introduced.
supersession_impact: The historical MO-016 raw-binding pilot remains available for internal certification compatibility. Ordinary user-answer evidence gains a separate publication-backed resolver path. Existing certification, publication-decision, and authoritative-publication authorities remain unchanged and are reused rather than superseded.
authority_impact: No authority is expanded. Authoritative publication remains the admission authority for USER_ANSWER evidence. Missing publication, missing evidence references, mismatched publication lineage, unknown products, and unpublished waiting-period facts fail closed. Internal certification remains distinct and cannot invoke the publication-backed resolver.
